runtime: Private PipeWire JACK 1.6.11 library from a verified Arch Linux package.

routes.capture: minifuze2_inputs12 FL -> Ardour mono Microphone track
routes.microphone_monitoring: MonitorDisk; microphone was recorded while music played.

checks.name: ardour_music_playback
checks.method: Operator confirmed clean stereo music playback through MiniFuse headphones.

checks.name: ardour_duplex_recording
checks.method: Ardour recorded approximately 15 seconds from Input 1 while playing music. The operator confirmed speaking; the saved mono file contained nonzero audio with no clipped samples.

checks.name: ardour_voice_replay
checks.method: The operator soloed the recorded Microphone track and confirmed clean voice playback in both headphones inside Ardour.

checks.name: ardour_session_saved
checks.method: The saved session contained one imported stereo music region and one recorded mono microphone region.

checks.name: system_audio_settings_preserved
checks.method: Default source/sink and forced PipeWire rate/quantum matched their initial values.

limits: One short session at 48 kHz; no endurance, small-buffer, plugin-load or other-rate qualification.
Xrun count is Ardour telemetry, not an independent count of audible dropouts.
Audio sources and session files remain private and are not included in the repository.
preparation_note: During automated session preparation, ImportToTrack with no selected track triggered an Ardour assertion. The session was reopened and the ordinary ImportAsTrack path succeeded. This is outside the MiniFuse mixer.
